failure_type: wind / gusts + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV failed due to a crosswind of 5.4 m/s combined with gusts reaching 5.9 m/s, which pushed the vehicle out of bounds. The flight was unsuccessful because the cruise speed of 9.2 m/s was too high to maintain stability under these conditions, as confirmed by the failure prevention when speed was reduced. Additionally, the planner's reliance on random seeds contributed to the failure, as re-seeding the RRT algorithm prevented the outcome.
